title: The Harvard USPTO Patent Dataset: A Large-Scale, Well-Structured, and Multi-Purpose Corpus of Patent Applications

bias_targets.methodology: Imputing the assigned sex of inventors and patent examiners using historical Social Security Administration (SSA) name data to analyze disparities in patent filing frequencies and application acceptance rates between male and female groups.

Evaluating patent acceptance rates across different applicant entity sizes (small, micro, and large/undiscounted entities) to measure disparities affecting independent inventors and small businesses with limited resources.
Measuring the state-level geographical distribution of US-based inventors and comparing the average patent acceptance rates across different states to identify regional disparities.
